scoring_justification: Agent's final scalar results are compared against paper-reported gold numbers with tolerances; raw DFT outputs not submitted for recompute.

schema.description: Line 1: PBE bandgap (eV); Line 2: HSE06 bandgap (eV).

outputs.description: Bandgaps of pristine p1 Li₂S₂ computed with PBE and HSE06 functionals.

schema.description: Line 1: formation energy of V_Li⁻ (eV); Line 2: formation energy of p⁺ (eV).

outputs.description: Formation energies of the dominant charged defects in p1 Li₂S₂.

schema.description: Single value: diffusion barrier of p⁺ along [001] in eV.

outputs.description: CI-NEB energy barrier for hole polaron migration along the [001] direction.

schema.description: Single dimensionless number: ratio of electronic conductivity (p⁺) to ionic conductivity (V_Li⁻) at 300 K.

outputs.description: Estimated conductivity ratio at room temperature, quantifying the dominance of hole polaron transport.

output_contract.notes: All values correspond to the p1 Li₂S₂ structure. Chemical potentials follow standard phase‑equilibrium references. Conductivity ratio uses the harmonic mean of diffusion barriers along the studied directions.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for all four scored artifacts
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper manuscript: bandgaps from Figure 1 and text (1.7 eV PBE, 2.8 eV HSE06); defect formation energies stated as 0.77 eV for V_Li⁻ and p⁺; diffusion barrier stated as ~13 meV (0.013 eV); conductivity ratio described as ~15 orders of magnitude (1e15).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from the paper's reported quantitative results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values are the actual paper-reported results; the reference solve.sh reproduces them exactly.

steps.description: Compare PBE and HSE06 bandgaps against paper gold
Compare V_Li⁻ and p⁺ formation energies against paper gold
Compare p⁺ diffusion barrier along [001] against paper gold
Compare conductivity ratio (electronic/ionic) within one order of magnitude
